measurementNotes: The source duration is the recorded production service duration.
The source byte count is the production R2 object size read with HeadObject.
The contract rate is the actual 2 GB for $12.50 residential-proxy order, with no order ID or account data stored.
Stored file bytes can undercount provider-billed protocol traffic, so this is a lower bound.
Core cost includes only the measured $0.156798 analysis anchor; other core stages can only increase the monthly result.
